neighbours.label: The opening piece 'Ber', 'Mer' or 'Mon' (and Arabic 'بر') at the very start of a text, as tested; other first tokens, and the same words later in a sentence, stay quiet.
fire: Bertha fed the hens at dawn.
Berries give the tea its scent.
quiet: Today Bertha fed the hens at dawn.
Even Mercury is a small planet.
Later Monet painted the pond often.
Spices give the tea its scent.

notes: Probes: 'Ber' 0.69, 'Mer' 0.75, 'Mon' 0.54 at the very start, 'بر' 0.55, whatever the word. 'Bern' 0.16, 'Mont' 0.12, 'Sun' 0.08, whole first tokens under 0.02; the word later in a sentence 0.00-0.30. Since the first token has no context, sentences that open with the same piece read the same by construction: this test measures the piece and the position only, and the top examples also include line starts ('Mon' after a newline), mid-sentence Arabic 'بر' after a clitic, and Japanese and Korean pieces that it does not cover.
